The user wants a push notification for a parking app. The user is parked at 信義停車場 (Xinyi Parking Lot), and their meter has 10 minutes remaining until expiry. Overtime costs NT$60 per hour.

Constraints:
- s1: string, max 16 characters
- s2: string, max 96 characters

Let me draft:

s1 options:
- "停車計時提醒" (6 chars)
- "停車即將到期" (6 chars)
- "車位時間快到了" (7 chars)

s1 should convey urgency. "停車計時倒數" = 6 chars. Or "計時快到期" = 5 chars.

Maybe "停車費將到期" (6) or with the parking lot name? "信義停車場提醒" = 7 chars.

Let me count characters carefully (Chinese chars count as 1 each if counting characters; but "字元" could mean characters — Chinese characters are 1 character each in most counting).

s1: "停車計時即將到期" = 8 chars. Good, under 16.

s2: needs to include: parking at 信義停車場, 10 minutes remaining, overtime NT$60/hour.

Draft s2: "您的愛車停在信義停車場，計時剩 10 分鐘到期，逾時每小時 NT$60，請留意時間！" 

Count: Let me count carefully.
"您的愛車停在信義停車場，計時剩 10 分鐘到期，逾時每小時 NT$60，請留意時間！"

您(1)的(2)愛(3)車(4)停(5)在(6)信(7)義(8)停(9)車(10)場(11)，(12)計(13)時(14)剩(15) (space)(16)1(17)0(18) (space)(19)分(20)鐘(21)到(22)期(23)，(24)逾(25)時(26)每(27)小(28)時(29) (space)(30)N(31)T(32)$(33)6(34)0(35)，(36)請(37)留(38)意(39)時(40)間(41)！(42)

42 characters. Well under 96. 

Could add urgency or suggestion to extend. Actually maybe suggest they can extend via app. But keep simple.

Alternative shorter: "信義停車場計時剩 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60，記得準時取車或加時！"

Count: 信(1)義(2)停(3)車(4)場(5)計(6)時(7)剩(8) (9)1(10)0(11) (12)分(13)鐘(14)，(15)逾(16)時(17)每(18)小(19)時(20) (21)N(22)T(23)$(24)6(25)0(26)，(27)記(28)得(29)準(30)時(31)取(32)車(33)或(34)加(35)時(36)！(37) = 37 chars.

Hmm, "加時" — extend. Maybe "可於 App 續停" would be useful if app supports. But we don't know. Keep to reminding.

Let me finalize:

s1: "停車即將到期" (6 chars)
s2: "信義停車場計時剩 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60，請留意取車時間！"

Count s2: 信1義2停3車4場5計6時7剩8␣9 1(10)0(11)␣12分13鐘14，15逾16時17每18小19時20␣21N22T23$24 6(25)0(26)，27請28留29意30取31車32時33間34！35 = 35 chars.

Under 96.

s1 could be more urgent: "計時快到期！" or "停車計時倒數中" (7). "停車計時提醒" is neutral. Since it's time-sensitive, maybe "停車計時快到期" (7 chars).

I'll go with:

{"s1":"停車計時快到期","s2":"信義停車場計時剩 10 分鐘，逾時每小時 NT$60，請留意取車時間！"}

Check s1 length: 停1車2計3時4快5到6期7 = 7 ≤ 16. Good.

s2 = 35 ≤ 96. Good.
